```plato

//==
// # Solver settings
//
// Two solvers, two settings records, because they parameterize genuinely
// different things: position-based dynamics is stiffness-as-a-proportion with
// an iteration count, and mass-spring is a Hookean force law with real units.
// Both share a step size and a substep count, because both are integrated the
// same way (position Verlet over `ClothVertex.PreviousPosition`).

// Settings for the position-based-dynamics solver
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Position-based_dynamics). TimeStep is one
// whole step, divided into SubStepCount equal substeps; IterationCount is how
// many constraint sweeps each substep runs.
//
// Stiffness is a PROPORTION in [0, 1]: the fraction of a constraint's error a
// single sweep removes. It is corrected for the iteration count before use
// (`IterationStiffness` in `cloth.library.plato`), so raising IterationCount
// makes the cloth converge better without also making it stiffer.
//
// VelocityDamping is the fraction of the implicit Verlet velocity removed each
// substep, in [0, 1); 0 is a lossless cloth and about 0.02 is a calm one.
type ClothSolverSettings
    implements IValue
{
    TimeStep: Duration;
    SubStepCount: Integer;
    IterationCount: Integer;
    Stiffness: Number;
    VelocityDamping: Number;
}
```
